source_snapshot.items_direct_xlsx: Test connections between BMC I2C-6 and UPHY0 from first PG548
source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: "【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). Log into the BMC and run the following command and ensure you get a reply. Refer to PID : 1114953 for other devices expected on the bus. i2cget -f -y 5 0x71 #Read MUX ports enabled i2ctransfer -y 5 w1@0x71 0x01 #Enable MUX Port 0""
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test."

test_case.purpose: Verify BMC I2C-6 reaches UPHY0 through first-PG548 mux0x71 port0 by observing the approved PID1114953 downstream replies, not merely the mux address or an invented physical probe.
required_package: PID1114953 first-PG548 mux0x71 port0 UPHY0 address/reply matrix
Proof logical BMC I2C-6 equals i2c-tools bus5
Mux register semantics for0x01, allowed combined bits and pre/post expected values
Bounded downstream commands with exit/reply/NACK/timeout criteria
Original-state restore and independent BMC recovery plan

Original mux byte, approved0x01 selection/readback and interpretation
